🇨🇳 Overview

China Overview

Everything you need to know before traveling to China – geography, culture, weather, visa, and tourism with a specialized Arabic-speaking guide

🌏 Complete Guide⏱️ 10 min read
Home›Tourism in China›Overview

China is one of the greatest travel destinations in the world — a civilization five thousand years old, giant cities bursting with life, breathtaking landscapes ranging from snowy mountains to tropical coastlines, and a diverse cuisine that amazes every visitor. Arcadia Tourism welcomes you on an extraordinary exploration of this fascinating country.

🌏 Essential Facts About China

China is the world's most populous country (1.4 billion people) and fourth largest by area. Its capital is Beijing, and its largest commercial city is Shanghai. The official language is Mandarin (Chinese), and the currency is the Chinese Yuan (CNY).

📋 Quick Facts

🗺️ Area: 9.6 million km² | 👥 Population: 1.4 billion | 🏙️ Capital: Beijing | 💰 Currency: Yuan (CNY) | 🗣️ Language: Mandarin | ⏰ Time Zone: UTC+8 (3 hours ahead of Saudi Arabia)

🗺️ Key Tourist Regions

China is divided into distinct tourist regions to suit all tastes:

  • North (Beijing and surroundings): Great Wall, Forbidden City, Summer Palace. The center of history and civilization.
  • East (Shanghai and Yangtze region): Skyscrapers, the historic Bund, Suzhou gardens. A perfect blend of modernity and heritage.
  • South (Guangzhou and Shenzhen): Center of trade and industry, close to Hong Kong. The top destination for Arab traders.
  • West (Chengdu and Sichuan): Home of the giant panda, famous spicy cuisine, Himalayan mountains.
  • Xinjiang (East Turkestan): A region with a Muslim majority, rich in mosques, Islamic heritage, and halal food.

☀️ Best Time to Visit

China is a vast country and the climate varies by region. Generally:

  • Spring (March – May): ✅ Ideal — mild weather, nature at its most beautiful.
  • Autumn (September – November): ✅ Excellent — pleasant weather and stunning fall colors.
  • Summer (June – August): ⚠️ Hot and humid in the south, acceptable in the north.
  • Winter (December – February): ❄️ Very cold in the north, mild in the south. Good prices.

💡 Avoid Chinese Holidays

Golden Week (early October) and Chinese New Year (January/February) are the busiest and most expensive periods. We recommend avoiding them or booking very far in advance.

🛂 Visa for Arab Citizens

Most Arab countries require a visa to enter China. The application process is relatively straightforward:

  • Valid passport for at least 6 months
  • Two passport photos with a white background
  • Confirmed hotel booking and return ticket
  • Visa application form (available on the consulate's website)
  • Visa fees: range from $50–140 depending on nationality

The standard visa is valid for 30 days and is issued within 4–7 working days. Arcadia Tourism helps you prepare the documents and submit the application.

🕌 China and Muslims

More than 23 million Muslims live in China, mostly Uyghurs and Hui. You'll find mosques in most major cities, and halal restaurants are widespread, especially in Xinjiang, Ningxia, Shanghai, and Beijing. See our Halal Food in China guide for full details.

💰 Tourism Costs

China is a destination that suits all budgets. The cost of living is low compared to Europe or Gulf countries. A good 3-star hotel starts from $50–80 per night, and a meal at a local restaurant is no more than $5–10. For full details see our China Tourism Cost Guide.

🚄 Getting Around China

China has the world's longest high-speed rail network. The train between Beijing and Shanghai (1,300 km) takes less than 5 hours. Domestic flights are available at reasonable prices. The metro in major cities is modern and easy to use. We recommend hiring a car with a driver to avoid the language barrier — which is exactly what Arcadia provides.

⭐ Why Choose Arcadia for Travel to China?

✅ Specialized Arabic-speaking guide in every city | ✅ Hotels with halal services | ✅ Flexible programs for individuals and groups | ✅ 5+ years of experience in Chinese tourism | ✅ 24/7 support throughout your trip

📱 Essential Apps in China

Before you travel: install WeChat for communication and payments, Maps.me for offline maps, and Google Translate with the camera feature to translate signs. Note that Google, WhatsApp, and YouTube are blocked in China — you'll need a VPN (activate it before arriving).
